summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on the periodic update of its ongoing share buyback program. The report details daily purchases of common shares on Euronext Milan and NYSE from May 11-15, 2026, under the second tranche of a multi-year ~€3.5 billion program, with no new strategic event announcement. Total consideration for the reported period was ~€27.2M, and the company has bought ~1.2M shares since January 2026. Treasury shares held as of May 15, 2026 represent 9.14% of common shares. This is a routine buyback update with no special-situation classification.
